articles.title_en: Ukrainian Drone Attack Kills Woman, Sparks Fire at Leningrad Region Refinery
articles.lead_en: Officials said unmanned aircraft targeted an industrial area that is home to the Kirishinefteorgsintez oil refinery, Russia’s second-largest.

articles.title_en: Olympic synchronized swimming champion Maria Shurochkina suffers severe burns in Moscow fire
articles.lead_en: Maria Shurochkina, a two-time Olympic synchronized swimming champion, was injured in a fire at her Moscow apartment, Russian media reported, including the state news agency TASS and the security services-linked Telegram channel Mash.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Leningrad region, sparking fire at one of the country’s largest oil refineries
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck the Leningrad region overnight on November 9, and 113 of them were shot down, Governor Alexander Drozdenko said.
